# Welcome to Marginalia

Marginalia is my personal reading diary: a place to keep track of the books I've read, record my thoughts, and follow how many pages I'm reading.

## Currently reading

The books I'm currently reading will appear here.

## Recent reads

My most recently finished books and short reviews will appear here.
